purpose: Compare original ACIC and Wasp on the same one-node Delta allocation using the existing Frontier road-eu-z input and independent digests.
prediction: If the road-usa-z gap is largely small-input amortization, ACIC/Wasp speedup should improve on the 228.7M-edge road-eu-z even on one node. This comparison cannot isolate size because OSM Europe has a different topology and weight distribution.
scope: One-node graph comparison, not a default-selection or distributed scaling result.
layout: One exclusive Delta cpu-interactive node; ACIC 16 processes x 7 workers, Wasp 32/64/128 OpenMP threads.
correctness: Every solve matches the Frontier-prepared road-eu-z full-graph digest. ACIC process layout, original scheduler, queue and selected width are verified from each log.
decision: Report per-source medians and geomean speedup Wasp/ACIC. A boundary-selected tuning setting limits any best-possible claim; test results must not feed back into selection.
